calls.prompt:
Create ONE 2D fighting-game CHARACTER REFERENCE SHEET of Aurelion (the Gilded Sovereign), an ORIGINAL character for an original
indie fighting game. It must NOT resemble any existing anime, manga, game or film character.

The FIRST attached image is the approved HOUSE STYLE (another character of this game): copy its rendering exactly - the same
premium high-detail anime fighting-game sprite style, line work, cel shading, metal highlights, proportions, scale and the
same kind of sheet layout - but draw Aurelion, NOT the character shown there. The SECOND attached image is Aurelion's portrait:
match the face, hair, colours and costume from it.

THE CHARACTER:
A slender, regal golden king, tall and straight-backed, chin lifted in arrogance. Fair flawless face with sharp cheekbones, a disdainful half-smile and heavy half-lidded CRIMSON eyes that glow faintly. Long pale GOLDEN hair, slicked straight back from the brow with no fringe, falling smoothly to the waist. Full armour of polished GILT GOLD plate with ivory-cream enamel panels: a high gilded gorget rising behind the neck with two spikes, sharp swept-back gold pauldrons ending in points, a fitted cuirass with a crimson enamel centre plate, gold gauntlets, a skirt of gold lames over plum-black trousers and polished gold greaves with pointed toes. A black velvet mantle hangs from his shoulders, its inside lined in CRIMSON silk that flashes as it swings. WEAPON: an ornate golden recurve BOW of gilded bronze, slimmer than a greatbow and about as tall as his head and shoulders, with sun-disc finials on both tips and a pale gold cord. He holds it extended forward in his LEFT hand at the wrapped grip and draws the cord with his RIGHT hand to the cheek. Energy and trails: molten GOLD light with a white-hot core, gold rift rings and gold sparks.

ART STYLE: Premium, high-detail anime 2D fighting-game sprite art: the look of a carefully hand-pixelled character sprite rendered at high resolution - crisp deliberate dark outlines (not thick black cartoon lines), cel shading with three to four tones per material, bright specular highlights on metal, a cool rim light, an expressive face with a clear eye, anatomically correct hands with readable fingers, convincing anime anatomy, fluid hair and cloth that follow the motion. Exactly the rendering, palette and level of detail of the attached reference sheet. Not vector art, not blurry, not chibi, no photorealism.

SHEET CONTENT (transparent background, image 1536x1024, no text, no labels, no grid lines, every figure separate):
- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right, chin lifted, the golden bow extended forward in the left hand; a three-quarter close-up of the head with golden hair slicked back and crimson eyes; a close view of the bow's sun-disc finials and gold grip
- second row: a combat stance with the bow held low; the full draw with the cord at the cheek; a stepping pose with the black mantle and crimson lining swinging; a jump with the bow raised
- third row: an arrow release with a molten-gold trail; a plunge with the bow pointed down and a golden arrow nocked; a fully drawn power shot inside a golden rift ring; a regal crouched guard
- bottom row: a hit reaction, a knocked-down pose, a victory pose with arms spread and a golden rift ring behind him, the Vault of Ages with golden portals firing a storm of golden weapons
Every figure faces RIGHT (three-quarter side view like the house style), the same scale (standing height about 240 px), feet on
the same ground line within each row.
